data.name: Scrapdivers
data.detailed_description:
A high-velocity, vertical extraction roguelite where you plunge into a fracturing world. Plummet into the abyss solo or with your crew, strip the grinding sky islands of every scrap of value, and escape back to your flying fortress before the creeping rot claims you.

DIVE

Step out into the void and let gravity take the wheel. The sky islands aren't static - they drift, collide, and shatter creating a vertical, high-stakes junkyard that changes with every single drop. Master and maintain breakneck momentum, swing between grinding landmasses.

SCRAP

If it isn’t nailed down, it’s yours. Use your high-powered terrain tool to rip through solid rock, carve out hidden veins of rare ore, and harvest precious crystals. You aren’t just fighting the environment; predators and gargantuan worms feed on the planet's decay. Tear them apart and claim the high-tier loot they guard.

CRAFT

Back aboard the Cloud Cutter, scrap becomes your ultimate weapon. Feed your hard-earned haul into the grinder to crush raw junk down into high-grade engineering parts. Re-build the remains of the old world to unlock rare blueprints, forge devastating weapons, and build out a modular kit designed to survive the hostile environment below.

UPGRADE

When you dive into the heart of the storm, you need more than luck. Upgrade your gear and fortify your abilities to radically stack your survival odds. If you fall to the void, your hauled loot is lost to the abyss - but your favorite tools, armor, and core abilities are permanently anchored to your soul. You’ll return to safety battered, but you will always dive back stronger.

FIGHT

Take the Cloud Cutter directly into the eye of the storm. As you dive deeper toward the fracturing core of the planet, you'll take on high-stakes extraction contracts to reclaim lost technology and uncover what is actively destroying this world. The storm is brewing, the rot is eating the horizon, and the core is waiting.

THE CLOUDS ARE YOUR HOME. THE GROUND IS YOUR GRAVE.
